definitions.explanation: The front part of the head, containing the eyes, nose, and mouth.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{顔|かお}が{赤|あか}くなりました。
{嬉|うれ}しい{顔|かお}をしています。
examples.notes: 顔をする = to have an expression

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{顔|かお}はどこかで{見|み}たことがあります。
examples.english: I've seen his face somewhere before.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}、{鏡|かがみ}で{顔|かお}を{見|み}たら、{目|め}が{赤|あか}くなっていて{驚|おどろ}きました。
examples.english: In the morning, when I looked at my face in the mirror, I was surprised to see my eyes were red.

notes:
{顔|かお} refers to the face, and is used for both the physical face and facial expressions. Also used figuratively in many idioms.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {顔|かお}を{洗|あら}う: to wash one's face
- {顔|かお}を{出|だ}す: to show up, make an appearance
- {顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}い: well-connected (lit. wide face)
- {顔|かお}を{立|た}てる: to save face, show respect
- {顔|かお}がきく: to have influence

FACIAL EXPRESSIONS:
- {嬉|うれ}しい{顔|かお}: happy face
- {悲|かな}しい{顔|かお}: sad face
- {怒|おこ}った{顔|かお}: angry face
- {顔|かお}をする: to make a face, have an expression

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {目|め}: eye
- {鼻|はな}: nose
- {口|くち}: mouth
- {頭|あたま}: head
